message: pnpm-workspace.yaml does not match depcurfew.json: `dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds: true` comes in through the merge key << at line 4 and should be `dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds: false`; depcurfew apply writes it into the map itself, where it wins over merged keys
fix: Run depcurfew apply to bring pnpm-workspace.yaml back in line with depcurfew.json (depcurfew apply --dry-run shows the change first), or change depcurfew.json if the edit was intended
